name: Lucas Ferreira
aboutParagraphs: Keeps clinics answering patients even after the front desk closes.
Lucas specializes in healthcare automation, having built WhatsApp funnels for over 50 clinics. His after-hours templates alone have recovered an average of 35% of previously missed patient inquiries.

reviews.name: Dr. Carolina Melo
reviews.text: After installing Lucas's template, we stopped losing patients to competitors who replied faster. Our booking rate jumped 40% in the first month.

reviews.name: Fernanda Ribeiro
reviews.text: The setup was smooth and the support from Lucas was excellent. Patients love the fast replies, even on weekends.
